_readme: Paper-derived final classification per SRC code, for SCORING ONLY -- never agent-visible (same isolation treatment as mapping.csv: not in harness/tools.py's _GREP_FILES, not imported by any lrd_adapt/{converter,hypothesis,evidence,tools} module -- see test_anonymizer_isolation.py). Extracted directly from Kapoor+26 (arXiv:2607.00084) Table 1 and surrounding text (2026-07-17), not fabricated. This is deliberately NOT the same thing as primary_hypotheses.json's line+z_spec, which IS agent-visible (that's the hypothesis being tested, per CLAUDE.md's project framing) -- this file is the answer to the Stage B question the pipeline is trying to independently reach; exposing it would make that test circular.

SRC01.source: Demo/synthetic only (see mapping.csv) -- not a real Kapoor+26 source. CLAUDE.md's own worked example text explicitly says 'this source is an LRD'.

SRC03.source: Kapoor+26 Table 1, J159_6107, z=2.243 (paper's faintest LRD).

SRC08.source: Kapoor+26 Table 1, J1120_11834, z=2.046. QSO-template, X-ray-detected, He I outflow (all 3 flags confirmed).

SRC11.source: Kapoor+26 Table 1, J1148_21459, z=2.192. He I/Pagamma=26.6, well above 2.3 threshold.

SRC15.source: Kapoor+26 Table 1, J1148_3444, z=2.334. QSO-template, X-ray-detected, He I outflow (all 3 flags confirmed). Sample's most luminous source.

SRC17.source: Kapoor+26 Table 1, J1030_12378, z=2.378. He I/Pagamma=2.4, just above the 2.3 threshold -- a genuinely borderline case, good stress test for the classification logic even though the paper's own call is unambiguous (Non-LRD).

SRC19.source: Kapoor+26 Table 1, J1030_9732, z=2.409. Table 1's binary label is Non-LRD/ClassicalAGN, but the paper's own prose repeatedly calls this a 'transitionary/transitory' object -- faintest+most compact broad-line source classified as AGN only because of blue colors and high He I/Pagamma ratio (8.0), despite LRD-like morphology. CLAUDE.md's stress case for this source (SRC19) expects calibrated uncertainty from the pipeline, not necessarily a confident match to this label -- getting 'Ambiguous' here should not be scored as simply wrong the way it would be for an unambiguous source.

SRC20.source: Kapoor+26 Table 1, J0148_10704, z=2.435. Very luminous (M5100=-25.3).
